clips.title: The story
paras: Within Blackfathom Deeps, Lady Sarevess works dark sorceries in the flooded ruins.
Lady Sarevess performs rituals in a flooded grotto within the Pool of Ask'ar. The Twilight's Hammer cultists haunt the sunken temple too, pursuing their own worship deeper in the cavern.
Lady Sarevess commands elemental currents and crackling lightning. Loyal naga sentinels and summoned water elementals guard her sanctuary as she fights intruders who threaten her dark work.
